findings.title: QUEENS PUBLIC LIBRARY RANSOMWARE CRIPPLES 66 BRANCHES
findings.comment: Wi-Fi, checkout machines, and the website all walked the plank while 2.3 million New Yorkers just wanted to return a library book, ye scallywags.

findings.title: ANUBIS CREW DEPLOYS NEW LINDNOR BACKDOOR, GETS FOILED ANYWAY
findings.comment: Thirteen security killers and five vulnerable drivers in under an hour, and still the encryption payload sank before it sailed — Hawkmoth's crew brought a cannon to a knife fight and missed.

findings.title: NEW SOUL GANG POSTS 25 VICTIMS WITHIN HOURS OF LAUNCH
findings.comment: A leak site this polished on day one smells less like a scrappy upstart and more like a rebrand wearin' a fake beard.

findings.title: N0N GANG CLAIMS 115 VICTIMS, ONE THIRD OF NOVEMBER'S HAUL
findings.comment: 355 claimed victims in nine days across 45 crews — the extortion economy's never looked healthier, which is to say everyone else's week has never looked worse.

findings.title: BARRACUDA GROUP CLAIMS GERMAN ARCHITECTURE FIRM ADG BLATT
findings.comment: Blueprints and client contracts up for sale at fifty grand, no proof offered beyond the gang's own word — buyer beware, or don't buy at all, ye fools.

findings.title: SOUL RANSOMWARE GANG DEBUTS WITH 25 VICTIMS
findings.comment: A brand-new crew calling itself Soul dropped 25 victims on its leak site in one day. Either veterans in fresh colors or the fastest shipwrights the seas have seen, nobody can say yet.

findings.title: STORM-3358 WIELDS AGENTIC AI FRAMEWORK ON BANKS
findings.comment: Microsoft tracks Cambodia-based Storm-3358 turning the ARTEX agentic AI framework loose on Southeast Asian banks since October. Robbers letting the robots row the longboat now.

findings.title: COZY BEAR WATERING HOLE HARVESTS PHONES
findings.comment: Sekoia fingers APT29 with moderate-to-high confidence for Poisoned Source, poisoning an analytics script to swipe cookies and Wi-Fi passwords from unpatched iPhones in Ukraine. SVR crooks squatting in the watering hole.

findings.title: OPENSSH AUTH BYPASS EXPLOITED
findings.comment: Arrr, oversized passwords now unlock Alpine boxes, and attackers reached post-exploitation before many captains had read the advisory.

findings.title: CODING-AGENT SECRETS EXPOSED
findings.comment: Over a thousand public Claude settings files reportedly carried credentials, while honeypots caught fresh probing; “don’t ask again” became “steal me later.”
